violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

(Deli meat and cheese ) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

(Herbs ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (top of the ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/01/2026

The floors and walls in walk in coolers have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
Management's plan for assessing, monitoring, and controlling foodborne disease hazards is inadequate. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Hose and scrub brush were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine, slicer, meat grinder) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

(Various food product) was observed held at (47-75) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of food product. See disposal New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

(Cheeses) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

Thermometers are lacking in the (all ) refrigeration unit(s). Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

(Rice and herbs ) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The presence of (flies ) is not controlled as evidenced by (live activity ). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
Inspector observed cat food, carriers, and litter box in retail area and basement. PIC was informed to remove all items from establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (back area ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
(Various food product ) were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in cooler and retail area ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Inspector observed staff cleaning a food scraper on trash can rim. PIC informed to cease practice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The ice scoop is stored on an unclean surface (on top of ice machine) between uses. During pauses in food preparation, utensils must be stored on a clean surface or in a clean, protected location. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026

The cutting boards in the (meat dept ) are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

(The open case cooler ) located in the (produce area ) area was not in good repair. Ambient temperatures observed at 57DF. Establishment not allowed to store any TCS food product in unit until repaired and/or replaced. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the (all refrigeration units ) have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Inspector observed bent faucet head making it inadequate to reach all 3 compartment bins and leakage.PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (outside dumpster and basement ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
The (ceiling ) in the (retail ) area is in poor repair. Observed water stains The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026

The floors and walls throughout the walk in cooler and meat department have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/18/2026
Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the (walk in cooler in basement). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024
All handwashing sink in the establishment is lacking signage. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of black/brown residue. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out of service.PIC to wash and sanitize equipment. PIC voluntarily disposed of ice. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2024

Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the (produce area, walk in cooler, and walk in freezer ). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 06/20/2024

The following non-food contact surfaces observed with debris: 1.non food contact surfaces of the slicer. 2.honey combs vents in grab n go cooler 3.shelves in walk in cooler 4.pvc pipes in meat cooler New Violation. Correct By: 06/20/2024

The outside refuse area observed with an accumulation of trash, litter, and/or other debris. Outside refuse area must kept clean as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2024
The wall in the (basement area) area is in poor repair. Observed a hole in wall. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2024

The floors, walls, and ceilings in the walk in cooler and meat cooler, have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/21/2024
